title: Conference-matrix MDS code conjecture
statement: Let $p$ be a prime, and let ${\mathbb C}$ be a code of length $p+1$ constructed from a generator matrix that is a conference matrix. **Conference-matrix MDS conjecture.** The code ${\mathbb C}$ is an MDS code of dimension $\frac{p+1}{2}$ and minimum Hamming distance $\frac{p+3}{2}$. This would give an MDS code with parameters determined by the rank of a conference matrix over ${\mathbb Z}_p$; the source provides no resolution of the claim.
source_name: Tuvi Etzion, Alexander Vardy and Eitan Yaakobi, “Coding for the Lee and Manhattan Metrics with Weighing Matrices”, arXiv:1210.5725 (2012).
